## Row

```{python}
from google.cloud import bigquery
import plotly.express as px

client = bigquery.Client(project="portfolio-hub-464520")

df = client.query("""
    select main_category, article_count
    from `portfolio-hub-464520.dbt_dev.mart_category_totals`
    order by article_count desc
""").to_dataframe()

fig = px.bar(df, x="main_category", y="article_count", title="Articles by category")
fig.show()
```
